title: 行动前选择：长程工具使用智能体的比较价值估计
summary: 论文提出CITA方法，训练比较推理模型（CIM），在执行工具调用前估计其长程价值。CIM结合观测行为、贝叶斯工具图模拟器监督和LLM语义判断，在三个工具使用基准上提升了Tool F1和任务成功率。
summary_en: The paper proposes CITA, which trains a Comparative Inference Model (CIM) to estimate the long-horizon value of a candidate tool invocation before executing it. CIM combines observed tool behavior, supervision from a Bayesian tool-graph simulator, and LLM-based semantic judgments, improving Tool F1 and task success across three tool-use benchmarks.
